ribbonSelectionTransform.label: New Object
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-cube-plus "><path d="M21 12.5v-4.509a1.98 1.98 0 0 0 -1 -1.717l-7 -4.008a2.016 2.016 0 0 0 -2 0l-7 4.007c-.619 .355 -1 1.01 -1 1.718v8.018c0 .709 .381 1.363 1 1.717l7 4.008a2.016 2.016 0 0 0 2 0"></path><path d="M12 22v-10"></path><path d="M12 12l8.73 -5.04"></path><path d="M3.27 6.96l8.73 5.04"></path><path d="M16 19h6"></path><path d="M19 16v6"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: The selection is the object "SX-HA86-011A" already — the ribbon and the gizmo move it. Select other items to make another; a selection inside an object becomes its sub-object and rides on it.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Move
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show the move gizmo on the current object in the viewport (make the selection an object first: New Object)

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Rotate
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show the rotate gizmo on the current object in the viewport (make the selection an object first: New Object)

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Scale
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show the scale gizmo on the current object in the viewport (make the selection an object first: New Object)

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Set Pivot
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-crosshair "><path d="M4 8v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h2"></path><path d="M4 16v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><path d="M16 20h2a2 2 0 0 0 2 -2v-2"></path><path d="M9 12l6 0"></path><path d="M12 9l0 6"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Place the object's pivot by hand: drag the arrows, then Lock. Rotate and scale turn around it, the gizmo sits on it, and the Transform Objects list shows it as the Pivot offset.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Reset
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-restore "><path d="M3.06 13a9 9 0 1 0 .49 -4.087"></path><path d="M3 4.001v5h5"></path><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Drop the hand-placed pivot: back on the side picked under Pivot in the Transform Objects list (the centre by default)

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Lock
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shown while placing the pivot: keep this position — it becomes the object's pivot.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Cancel
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shown while placing the pivot: discard this placement — the pivot stays where it was.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Item Pivot
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shown while placing the pivot: while on, click an item in the 3D view to move the pivot to its centre.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Auto Disable
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-arrows-exchange "><path d="M7 10h14l-4 -4"></path><path d="M17 14h-14l4 4"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Automatically disarm the gizmo, pivot placement and move-to-click when you leave this ribbon: switching to another ribbon tab, or changing layout via the App Layout ribbon or the F-keys. Keeps a mode that reacts to viewport clicks from staying armed while you work elsewhere. A locked pivot is kept — it is a position, not a mode. Default on.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Move To Click
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-target-arrow "><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path><path d="M12 7a5 5 0 1 0 5 5"></path><path d="M13 3.055a9 9 0 1 0 7.941 7.945"></path><path d="M15 6v3h3l3 -3h-3v-3l-3 3"></path><path d="M15 9l-3 3"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Arm, then click a point in the 3D view — the current object (while animating: the selection, as a pose) moves there with its bottom aligned to the clicked point (undoable)

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: mm
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Step unit: millimeters

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: cm
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Step unit: centimeters

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: m
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Step unit: meters

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Step −
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Decrease the transform step

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Step +
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Increase the transform step

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: R
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Move one step toward RIGHT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: L
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Move one step toward LEFT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: B
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Move one step toward BACK

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: F
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Move one step toward FRONT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: T
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Move one step toward TOP

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Bo
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Move one step toward BOT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Bigger
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-zoom-in "><path d="M3 10a7 7 0 1 0 14 0a7 7 0 1 0 -14 0"></path><path d="M7 10l6 0"></path><path d="M10 7l0 6"></path><path d="M21 21l-6 -6"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Grow the object evenly: its largest side gets one step longer

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Smaller
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-zoom-out "><path d="M3 10a7 7 0 1 0 14 0a7 7 0 1 0 -14 0"></path><path d="M7 10l6 0"></path><path d="M21 21l-6 -6"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shrink the object evenly: its largest side gets one step shorter

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: T→F
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Rotate 90° so TOP faces FRONT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: T→B
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Rotate 90° so TOP faces BACK

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: T→L
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Rotate 90° so TOP faces LEFT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: T→R
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Rotate 90° so TOP faces RIGHT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: F→R
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Rotate 90° so FRONT faces RIGHT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: F→L
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Rotate 90° so FRONT faces LEFT

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Reset Obj
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-restore "><path d="M3.06 13a9 9 0 1 0 .49 -4.087"></path><path d="M3 4.001v5h5"></path><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Put the current transform object back where the model has it

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Reset All
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-restore "><path d="M3.06 13a9 9 0 1 0 .49 -4.087"></path><path d="M3 4.001v5h5"></path><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Put every transform object back where the model has it (the objects stay in the list)

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: List
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-list "><path d="M9 6l11 0"></path><path d="M9 12l11 0"></path><path d="M9 18l11 0"></path><path d="M5 6l0 .01"></path><path d="M5 12l0 .01"></path><path d="M5 18l0 .01"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show / hide the Transform Objects list

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Undo
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-arrow-back-up "><path d="M9 14l-4 -4l4 -4"></path><path d="M5 10h11a4 4 0 1 1 0 8h-1"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Undo the last change to the transform objects

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Redo
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-arrow-forward-up "><path d="M15 14l4 -4l-4 -4"></path><path d="M19 10h-11a4 4 0 1 0 0 8h1"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Redo the last undone change to the transform objects
